name: The Westin St. Francis San Francisco on Union Square
insider_take: Historic grandeur meets modern luxury in the heart of San Francisco's most iconic square.
whats_special: This legendary hotel has been the "Grande Dame" of Union Square since 1904, surviving the great earthquake and hosting everyone from royalty to Hollywood stars. The famous glass elevators offer stunning city views as you ascend, and the coin-washing tradition in the basement ensures every guest receives pristine currency - a unique service that's been running since the 1930s.
pro_tip: Book a room on the higher floors of the historic tower for spectacular views of Union Square and the bay, plus you'll experience the charm of the original 1904 architecture.
dont_miss: Step into the opulent lobby with its Austrian crystal chandeliers and marble columns, then head to the Clock Bar for their famous Pisco Punch - a cocktail recipe that's been served here for over a century. Union Square's premier shopping and the cable car turnaround are literally at your doorstep.
pros: Prime location directly on Union Square with exceptional walkability to shopping and attractions
Historic luxury landmark hotel with elegant architecture and timeless San Francisco charm
Exceptional concierge and guest services with knowledgeable local recommendations
Premium Westin amenities including signature Heavenly Beds and WestinWORKOUT fitness facility
cons: Historic building with older room configurations and varying room sizes
Urban location with typical city noise levels from busy Union Square area
